description: This Java file defines a Fragment for an Android app that manages user login status and interacts with a cloud storage provider via content resolver notifications. It includes methods for toggling login, persisting login state with SharedPreferences, and updating the UI menu accordingly.

classes.name: StorageProviderFragment
classes.description: Fragment that manages user login state and notifies the system of storage provider changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restores login status, and sets options menu availability.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates the menu item title based on login status.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, toggles login, and notifies system of changes.

methods.name: toggleLogin
methods.description: Toggles the user's login state and logs the action.

methods.name: writeLoginValue
methods.description: Persists the login state in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readLoginValue
methods.description: Retrieves the login state from SharedPreferences.
